mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient (patientName, password, phone, email, sex, age, oldHistory, allergiesHistory, habits) VALUES (#{patientName}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{sex}, #{age}, #{oldHistory}, #{allergiesHistory}, #{habits})
mapper.update: UPDATE patient SET patientName = #{patientName}, sex = #{sex}, age = #{age}, oldHistory = #{oldHistory}, allergiesHistory = #{allergiesHistory}, habits = #{habits} WHERE patientId = #{patientId} LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT patientId, patientName, phone, email, sex, age, oldHistory, allergiesHistory, habits FROM patient WHERE patientId = #{patientId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM patient WHERE phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1
